race.comment: FEARFUL (10) has been solid in finishing midfield in three starts here since coming from the outside barrier to place at Newcastle. He may require some luck from this barrier but finds a winnable assignment. JACQUELINE ROSE NZ (5) comes back in grade on the latest attempt and had looked close to a win when placed in two of her previous three outings. Looks suited here. TRIED AND TRUSTED (6) drew on the back row last start so it may pay to forgive that result. Had placed in three of his previous four outings, two of them at this circuit and distance, so may be worth another chance. WARRAWEES SHOUT (4) broke last start but has been racing consistently prior including a fourth from a wider barrier here prior.
